dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'C' shaped high-intensity perimeter located near the dorsal-median ridge with a sharp exterior-to-interior dark gradient. Several smaller 'O' shaped closed-loop geometries with thin high-intensity borders are distributed across the mid-lateral field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, point-like high-intensity pixel clusters dispersed across the lower lateral region. Core concentrations are highest in the mid-body section where blobs transition into more amorphous high-contrast patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary trapezoidal spatial relationship is formed by connecting the centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the upper-mid dorsal quadrant. A secondary acute-angled triangle is formed by the centroids of three distinct high-intensity blobs near the posterior-lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct triangular protrusion on the dorsal-median line exhibiting vertical, high-contrast linear striations contrasting against the darker background.
